name: AmorecoFlix
description: Personal Netflix-style player for a USB drive plugged into the TV: posters, synopses, continue watching, next episode, skip intro, audio and subtitle choice. No server needed; PowerShell scripts in the repo organise the library on a PC. Portuguese UI.
pre_build: rm -rf tizen-stage && mkdir tizen-stage && cp -R config.xml index.html app.js style.css icon.png js fonts tizen-stage/
